dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Freddy is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Freddy has been observed to be inconsistent in his dog reactivity. When seeing other dogs he is noted to hard pull, barking, screaming, staring. He has also displayed overly aroused, mouthy behavior toward handlers grabbing onto handler clothing when in the play yard. Freddy is noted to be social with familiar staff and checks in with handlers socially on walks. Medically, Freddy is apparently healthy.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I love getting pets and - you guessed it - snuggles!

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!

I am playful and cute!
dog.name: Freddy
